name: ogsr-nvrhi
description: NVRHI (NVIDIA-RTX/NVRHI main) for OGSR Engine: static libraries nvrhi (with the validation layer), nvrhi_d3d11 and nvrhi_d3d12; no Vulkan, NVAPI, Aftermath or RTXMU; DirectX-Headers from vcpkg; 21 OGSR patches (portfile.cmake): semantic index base, D3D11 deferred command lists and lower binding cost, native shader / layout / pipeline handles, sampler and 3D RTV additions, null bindings, D3D12 view cache lock, lower D3D12 draw cost (references once, volatile CB addresses, buffer-only draws), the textures a D3D12 list uses (residency), a lock around the D3D12 root signature cache.
